m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: We welcome you back to Crab Alley, dearest, closest friend Wizard! What was your name again?
Ah, of course! We will never forget what you did. Now, what can the illustrious king of Crab Alley do for you today?
The Tower of Peladon? That place is haunted. And forsaken. And forbidden. But for you, we'll lift the ban.
Go forth, plucky Wizard, into the Tower of Peladon and find that which you seek!
You'll have to fight whatever has moved into that dank place for the Thaumaturgical Globe of Peladon. Bring it back to me.
Hello, Wizard. Nice to be seen again. You've got the Thaumaturgical Globe of Peladon? Let me teach you the summoning ritual.
Travel to Crab Alley, and find King Thermidor. Get his permission to search the Tower of Peladon in the Deep Warrens.
Get permission from King Thermidor to search the Tower of Peladon, and find the Globe of Peladon!
Hello-o-o-o. Come on, then! Wait, am I supposed to be following you? Ah, you are searching for a new Minion! Splendid!
Freddo the Ice Fish? Now where is my five hundred day diary? I remember jotting some notes on Freddo... ah yes!
